sids/index_json.note: 27 index JSONs per category: {rqvae,rqkmeans,MQ} x {3,4,5}cb x {128,256,512}. rqvae and MQ can never be regenerated; rqkmeans only non-deterministically.

sids/mispacked.note: Pre-repair rqkmeans originals, kept as evidence for the 2026-08-20 bit-unpacking repair. AR rqkmeans 5cb x 512 was trained on these.

sids/sem_ids/diffgrm.note: ASIN-keyed raw codes consumed by the diffusion tokenizer.

sids/sem_ids/diffgrm_new.note: Two-item tree copy. Should agree byte-for-byte with diffgrm/.

sids/mappings.note: Forward/inverse maps. tokens2item is LOSSY (last writer wins on collision) -- use cb2items for any item-level decode.

sids/info/next-item.note: SID <tab> title <tab> item_id. Sole input to the constrained-decoding trie.

data/embeddings.note: Pre-quantization item embeddings. Qwen3-Embedding-4B, mean-pooled over [title, description], NO PCA, NO L2 norm. (3105, 2560) / (17696, 2560) fp16. The 'sentence-t5-base_pca256' in DiffGRM filenames is an artifact -- external mode short-circuits before any sentence encoding runs.

data/item_meta.note: title/brand/description present; `categories` empty for every item.

data/id_maps.note: ASIN <-> OneDiffRec int id. DiffGRM id == OneDiffRec id + 1.

ckpt/diffusion/next1_logs.note: The ONLY per-checkpoint config record. Recovers every shape-visible field; n_head is NOT recoverable from these and comes from the vendored sbatch.

ckpt/diffusion/next2.note: Two-item diffusion. One run may still be training.

ckpt/ar/next-item_best.note: = rqkmeans 3cb x 128. Post-repair. The retraining anchor.

ckpt/ar/oneoff_rqvae4cb128.note: = rqvae 4cb x 128 (423 SID tokens), from run_sft.sbatch not the sweep, so it is NOT the model behind the published row. Second validation anchor; also the source of the measured run-to-run noise floor.

base_models/qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct.note: AR base model, needed for retraining.

results/sweep_metrics.note: 28 runs x {metrics.json, assets.json, predictions.json, eval.log}. metrics.json carries eval_loss_curve / best_model_checkpoint / stopped_at_step -- the AR retraining validation targets. predictions.json is 3681 samples x 50 ranked beams.

results/sweep_state.note: Per-variant status + train_seconds; the run-timeline evidence.

results/diffusion_transcripts/next1.note: Full train+eval transcripts; tail carries the Test Results OrderedDict.

results/wandb.note: Offline runs: FLOPs, GPU energy, wall time.

results/job_manifests.note: Upstream's own per-job provenance (git head, source.patch, pip-freeze).

results/diagram_data/v1.note: diagrams/README.md is the clearest existing statement of the SID-level vs item-level metric problem.

results/diagram_data/v2.note: 18 tidy CSVs incl. the 54-run core grid and W&B resource joins.

results/collision_workbook.note: Hand-maintained source for the published collision tables.
